title: Unitarizability implies amenability for discrete groups
summary: We prove that a discrete group is amenable if and only if every uniformly bounded representation on a complex Hilbert space is similar to a unitary representation. This resolves Dixmier's unitarizability problem affirmatively for discrete groups.
family_title: Amenability, unitarizability, and strong Ulam stability

review.reason: Proves an equivalence between amenability and unitarizability of bounded representations for discrete groups.
